texts.zh:
神迹出现了！受到宗教狂热的驱使，[Target.GetName]上虔诚的[Root.Owner.GetResearchers]已夺取了空间站的控制权。据他们称，他们获得了启示，现在打算径直前往黑洞中心，履行一桩自我毁灭的精神使命。

武装人员目前正在试图夺回空间站的控制权。
texts.en:
An epiphany! Driven by religious fervor, pious [Root.Owner.GetResearchers] aboard the [Target.GetName] have seized control of the station. They claim to have received a vision, and are now heading straight to the center of the black hole in a spiritual quest for self-annihilation.

Armed personnel are currently fighting to regain control of the station.

texts.zh:
在[Target.GetName]上的[Root.Owner.GetResearchers]被狂热冲昏了头脑，他夺取了空间站的控制权，并将其慢慢拐向黑洞——这番行为显然是出于近乎病态的科学好奇心、严重的鲁莽和对自己生命的彻底漠视。

武装人员目前正在试图夺回空间站的控制权。
texts.en:
Overenthusiastic [Root.Owner.GetResearchers] aboard the [Target.GetName] have seized control of the station and are now steering it towards the black hole - a move doubtlessly driven by insatiable scientific curiosity, an unhealthy amount of recklessness, and utter disregard for their own self-preservation.

Armed personnel are currently fighting to regain control of the station.

texts.zh:
“我们已经见过舰船被事件视界捕获后会发生什么了！我不想摊上这么个死法！”

在咆哮出他们的抗命之词后，我们的一位[Root.Owner.GetResearchers]夺取了空间站的控制权，并且将其缓缓驶离黑洞。

武装人员目前正在试图夺回空间站的控制权。此外，涉及到这一事故的相关物理知识将会从课本当中删除。
texts.en:
'We've seen what happens to ships caught in the event horizon! I don't intend to die like that!'

After screaming their defiance, one of our [Root.Owner.GetResearchers] seized control of the station and is now steering it away from the black hole.

Armed personnel are currently fighting to regain control of the station, and the incident referenced is being expunged from our physics textbooks.

texts.zh:
惊慌的[Root.Owner.GetResearchers]现在控制住了空间站并将其缓缓驶离黑洞。

武装人员目前正在试图夺回空间站的控制权。
texts.en:
Terrified [Root.Owner.GetResearchers] have seized control of the station and are now steering it away from the black hole.

Armed personnel are currently fighting to regain control of the station.

texts.zh: 经过了紧张的对峙，哗变人员最终被制服了，武装人员重新夺回了[Target.GetName]的控制权。
texts.en: After a tense confrontation, the mutineers have been dealt with, and armed personnel have regained full control of [Target.GetName].
